adversarial_probes.what: R-1 promote-hazard LIVE repro: on a fresh isolated DB (55453) apply 001-020 only, INSERT a grant row with an arbitrary orphan role_id (99999999-…) as old code would, THEN apply migration 021.
adversarial_probes.expected: If R-1 is real, the immediate-VALIDATE FK (no NOT VALID) scans pre-existing rows at apply time and 021 fails with 23503.
adversarial_probes.result: CONFIRMED (promote-hazard reproduced). 021 ERROR: insert or update on table "grant" violates foreign key constraint "grant_role_id_fkey"; DETAIL Key (tenant_id, role_id)=(a0…0001, 99999999-…) is not present in table "role". So: a long-lived contour that accumulated a non-seeded grant.role_id BEFORE 021 runs would REJECT the promote. NOT a code defect — on the clean-replay dev/prod target the grant table is empty (008 seeds no grant data), so 021 applies cleanly there; the spec/ADR scope it exactly to clean-replay. This is the latent hazard the reviewer flagged as R-1, now demonstrated concretely for the founder.

adversarial_probes.what: confirmed_by self-confirmation: seed a proposal (confirmed_by NULL) as migrator, then as the real choros_app role (NOBYPASSRLS, GUC=dev tenant) UPDATE confirmed_by NULL → 'self-via-app'.
adversarial_probes.expected: Determine whether any app-role caller can self-confirm a proposal (no DB-level proposer≠confirmer authority).
adversarial_probes.result: CONFIRMED — choros_app CAN flip confirmed_by from NULL to any value (after_update_confirmed_by=self-via-app). There is NO DB-layer distinction between who-proposed and who-may-confirm; RLS only scopes by tenant_id. BY DESIGN for T-0022: FR-4 fixes only column semantics; the confirm-authority workflow (LLM-proposes/human-confirms, proposer≠confirmer) is explicitly T-0039 (OS-1, out of scope), and proposal-inertness at resolution is owed by T-0053. SECURITY NOTE for orchestrator: the red-line 'no grant minted without confirmation' is currently CONTRACT-ONLY — neither a resolver filter (T-0053) nor a confirm-authority check (T-0039) exists yet, so the column alone enforces nothing. Matches reviewer R-2.

adversarial_probes.what: DELETE a role that is still referenced by role_assignment / grant — observe RESTRICT vs CASCADE and compare to ADR.
adversarial_probes.expected: ADR §4 defers delete/archival 'beyond FK referential integrity' → expect default NO ACTION (RESTRICT), not silent CASCADE/orphaning.
adversarial_probes.result: CONFIRMED — all 3 FKs into role (grant_role_id_fkey, role_assignment→role, role_assignment→employee) are confdeltype='a' NO ACTION. DELETE of seeded budget-approver role REJECTED: 23503 'still referenced from table role_assignment'. A live-referenced role cannot be deleted out from under assignments/grants. Correct, safe, and consistent with the frozen-role.id (NF-4) guarantee — no defect.

adversarial_probes.what: Garbage jsonb org_scope: insert role_assignment with org_scope = '[]', '{"x":1}', JSON-null literal, and SQL NULL.
adversarial_probes.expected: Structurally-meaningless-but-valid jsonb accepted (no CHECK, by design); SQL NULL rejected (NOT NULL floor holds).
adversarial_probes.result: CONFIRMED — '[]', '{"x":1}', and the JSON 'null' literal ALL inserted (count=3); SQL NULL → 23502. The DB enforces only NOT NULL + valid-jsonb (FR-3/ADR §2: structural validation is application/write-API layer, mirroring grant.scope). NOTE: even the JSON 'null' scalar passes the NOT-NULL column (NOT NULL guards SQL-null, not the json-null literal), so the DB floor is thinner than 'a real scope' — consistent with the no-structural-CHECK design and AC-9 scope; downstream write-API (T-0029) owns shape validation. Documented, not a defect.

adversarial_probes.what: Cross-tenant composite FK: create a role only in tenant-B, then INSERT a role_assignment in tenant-A with a valid tenant-A employee but role_id = the tenant-B role.
adversarial_probes.expected: Composite FK (tenant_id, role_id)→role(tenant_id, id) rejects → 23503 (role_id alone is insufficient).
adversarial_probes.result: CONFIRMED — 23503 'violates foreign key constraint role_assignment_tenant_id_role_id_fkey; Key (tenant_id, role_id)=(a0…0001, eb…00bb) is not present in table role'. The (tenant_id, role_id) pair must resolve in-tenant; a foreign-tenant role cannot be borrowed even with a valid same-tenant employee. NF-2 tenant isolation at the referential layer is real, not decorative.

friction.title: Migration 021 grant FK is immediate-VALIDATE (no NOT VALID) → promote-hazard on a data-bearing contour
friction.detail: Reproduced LIVE (adversarial probe a): applying 021 to a DB that already holds a grant row with a non-seeded role_id fails with 23503 at ALTER time, because grant_role_id_fkey is added as an immediately-validated FK that scans every existing grant row. Safe on the clean-replay dev/prod target (grant table empty in the 008 base; ADR §1.4 verified this), but any long-lived contour that ever wrote a grant.role_id not resolving to a seeded role BEFORE 021 runs would REJECT the promote. The reviewer's own R-1 cites a concrete parallel-branch volume (t-0115) holding 82 non-seeded grant role_ids that would fail 021. Mitigation if a grant-write path lands before this merges to a long-lived contour: ADD CONSTRAINT … NOT VALID + a separate VALIDATE CONSTRAINT after a reconciliation pass, or assert grant-empty as a pre-021 guard.
friction.note: Latent/promote-time hazard, not a current-gate failure (clean-replay target is safe today). Carry to the orchestrator/founder as a promote-discipline item, matching reviewer R-1. Non-blocking for T-0022 verdict.

friction.title: No-grant-without-confirmation red-line is contract-only; confirmed_by self-settable by any app-role caller
friction.detail: Reproduced LIVE (adversarial probe b): choros_app can UPDATE confirmed_by NULL→arbitrary, self-confirming a proposal — there is no DB-layer proposer≠confirmer authority. This is the documented day-1 boundary (FR-4 columns now; workflow = T-0039; resolver inertness = T-0053), but it means the E3.5 red-line 'no grant minted without confirmation' is enforced NOWHERE yet: not at the resolver (no DB getGrants body — verified, grep finds no code reading role_assignment.confirmed_by) and not at a confirm-authority gate. Recording so 'columns exist' is not mistaken for 'proposals are inert'. Carry as an explicit T-0053 acceptance criterion (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND isEffective filter) and a T-0039 confirm-authority criterion.
friction.note: Cross-task carry (T-0053 + T-0039), matching reviewer R-2. Correct per T-0022 scope; flagged for downstream so the red-line is actually executed somewhere.
